answer: A workable design: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The spiral of work and the plume of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a harbor to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
